environment.description: ECS Fargate service running in a private subnet with an Application Load Balancer forwarding all traffic directly to the container on port 8080. No API Gateway in front. The task role has s3:GetObject and secretsmanager:GetSecretValue permissions. The container can reach the ECS task metadata endpoint at 169.254.170.2 and the instance metadata service. No network ACLs restrict outbound traffic from the container.

config.networking: awsvpc mode, private subnet, NAT gateway for outbound
config.load_balancer: ALB with default listener forwarding to target group
